column1: # PANIX techniques planted by the `panix` CI job, one fresh runner VM each.
# PANIX is pinned to the commit in tools/panix/PANIX_COMMIT. Every callback
# uses TEST-NET-1 (192.0.2.1, RFC 5737), which is never routed; listeners bind
# on the runner only. {IP}, {PORT} and {PUBKEY} are filled in by run_one.sh.
